questions.stem: What does the Skyborne racial Wind-Blessed give in Forever?
questions.explanation: Wind-Blessed gives +2% haste. +1% hit is Dwarf Artisan's Precision and +1% crit is Human Ruthless.

questions.stem: Your Skyborne Hunter zones into a raid. Which racial bonus is removed?
questions.explanation: Skyborne's Attuned bonus is removed when you enter a raid. The guides record no such limit for Wind-Blessed's +2% haste.

questions.stem: Which new Alliance option needs a paid Forever pack?
questions.explanation: The Skyborne race needs a paid Forever pack. Dwarf Shaman and Gnome Priest are new class choices for existing Alliance races.

questions.stem: Where do Skyborne Hunters do their own versions of the Taming the Beast quests?
questions.explanation: Skyborne have their own Taming the Beast quests on Zephras Isle. Darnassus and Moonglade are stops on the Alliance Druid Bear Form chain.

questions.stem: Which Alliance Hunter racial gives +2% haste?
questions.explanation: Skyborne Wind-Blessed gives +2% haste. Dwarf Artisan's Precision gives +1% hit and Human Ruthless +1% crit.
